content: Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When this product is expired or no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly according to local regulations or guidelines. This information was last updated in May 2024. Important Usage Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. This medication has been prescribed solely for your current condition. Laboratory tests, such as kidney function assessments, complete blood counts, blood sugar levels, or cultures, may be conducted before starting this medication and periodically during its use to monitor your health and the medication's effects. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom, as the humidity may affect its stability. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer required. This information was last revised in May 2024. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized guidance regarding this product and your health.
